messages: The archeologist, Doctor #p512#, currently does research at a camping site in #m10004051#. He recently called me about a strange rumor he heard.

During the excavation, Doctor #p512# said he heard a rumor about a very old tree living in #m10004000#. However, he had no clue on what kind of tree it was, or where exactly it was located. That's why he's asked me to visit #b#m10004000##k village to collect information on this particular tree. Shall I start by visiting #b#p501##k?
I met #p501# in #m10004000#. Would he know anything about that tree?
name: Truth of the Rumor
